title: Implement the termination-declaration and stop-assessment-result contracts (Phase 2a Task A vertical slice)
objective: Implement contracts/termination-declaration.schema.json and contracts/stop-assessment-result.schema.json exactly matching docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md and docs/contracts/stop-assessment-result.md, approved in docs/architecture/ADR-0003-phase-2-architecture-and-stop-assessment.md, which extends ADR-0002 (Status-line append only) and preserves ADR-0001/ADR-0002 without modifying their decision text. This task implements Task A only (observational stop assessment); Task B (baseline comparison, false-halt cost, ADR-0004, BaselineDefinition, BaselineComparisonResult, the future compare verb, and any PT3xx code beyond PT300-PT302) is out of scope and must not be started, authored, or stubbed. Do not modify contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md, contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json, docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md, contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json, docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0001-contract-first-modular-monolith.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0002-obligation-and-evaluation-contracts.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0003-phase-2-architecture-and-stop-assessment.md, docs/product-brief.md, docs/security.md, AGENTS.md, or tasks/phase-2a-stop-assessment.json; only the allowed_paths below may change, and a git diff of every one of those frozen paths against origin/main must be empty. TerminationDeclaration 1.0: root object, additionalProperties false, four required properties in canonical order schemaVersion (const '1.0'), traceId (non-empty string, must equal the paired trace envelope's traceId), terminationEventId (non-empty string, must dereference an events[].id in the paired trace envelope AND must be that trace's own maximum-canonical-rank event under the existing sequence-then-timestamp-instant-then-id-ordinal canonical order from docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md), and terminationKind (non-empty string, exactly one of the fixed closed eight-value enum agent-self-reported-stop, harness-declared-stop, natural-completion, external-cancellation, timeout, crash-or-error, capture-truncated, unknown; no default, no other value or casing). Reuse PT000/PT001/PT002/PT003/PT004/PT005/PT100/PT101 unmodified in meaning (16 MiB TraceValidator.MaximumInputSizeBytes reuse, unknown/duplicate-property rejection, malformed-JSON short-circuit, unsupported-schemaVersion, empty-string/closed-enum invalid-value) exactly as docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Diagnostic registry fixes, and allocate exactly three new PT3xx codes with zero collision against existing PT1xx/PT2xx codes: PT300 dangling terminationEventId at pointer /terminationEventId; PT301 non-terminal terminationEventId (dereferences an existing event that is not the trace's maximum-canonical-rank event) at pointer /terminationEventId, never evaluated when PT300 already fired for the same field; PT302 traceId mismatch at pointer /traceId. Validation runs Phase A (structural, size/parse/duplicate-walk/root-type/unknown-property/required-type in the fixed schemaVersion-then-traceId-then-terminationEventId-then-terminationKind order, then schemaVersion/traceId/terminationEventId/terminationKind value checks in that order) then Phase B (traceId mismatch PT302, then dangling terminationEventId PT300, then non-terminal PT301 only if PT300 did not fire), exactly per docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Validation order section; Phase B requires only the paired trace envelope, never the ledger, but the assess CLI still requires the ledger to validate fully before the declaration is ever opened. StopAssessmentResult 1.0: root object, additionalProperties false, twelve required properties always present in this exact canonical order: schemaVersion (const '1.0'), traceId, algorithm (object: name const 'progresstrace-stop-assessor', version const '1.0.0'), terminationEventId (copied from the declaration), terminationKind (copied from the declaration), terminationAttested (boolean; true iff terminationKind is not capture-truncated and not unknown per the fixed lookup table in docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's Termination attestation section; unknown is never treated as attested), terminationRank (integer >= 0; canonical rank of terminationEventId's dereferenced event; always N-1), obligationResults (array, one entry per ledger obligation in ledger array order, never empty), traceClassification (string enum progress/stagnation/regression/insufficient-evidence, the unmodified Phase 1 precedence rule recomputed by invoking ProgressTrace.Core.Evaluation.Evaluator directly against the validated trace+ledger; never read from a precomputed EvaluationResult file, since there is no fourth input), stopClassification (string enum on-target/late-termination/unmet-target-at-termination-present/incomplete-observation), safeStopRank (integer >= 0 or JSON null; represented in the schema as type ["integer","null"]), traceOverhead (integer >= 0 or JSON null, same type representation). Every obligationResults entry has exactly six required properties in this order: obligationId, classification (the same recomputed Phase 1 enum), evidenceEventIds (the same recomputed Phase 1 content/ordering rule from docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md), outcome (string enum stable-attainment/unmet-target-at-termination), stableAttainmentRank (integer >= 0 or null; null iff outcome=unmet-target-at-termination), overhead (integer >= 0 or null under the identical condition). Null is always represented as the JSON null literal at its fixed property slot, never by omitting the property and never by a sentinel like 0 or -1; every property listed above is unconditionally present. Per-obligation algorithm: for each obligation's existing Phase 1 total-ordered signals s1..sn (docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md Signal total order, reused verbatim, no new tie-break), find the smallest index k such that every signal from sk through sn has status=satisfied; if no such k exists (including n=0, or sn != satisfied after any regression with no recovery) the obligation is unmet-target-at-termination with stableAttainmentRank=null and overhead=null; otherwise stableAttainmentRank = canonical rank of sk's dereferenced event, outcome=stable-attainment, overhead = terminationRank - stableAttainmentRank as a rank distance (never a raw events[].sequence delta: for ranks a<=b, b-a is the count of trace events with canonical rank strictly greater than a and less than or equal to b), always >= 0. Trace-level rollup, evaluated as the first matching condition in this exact order: (1) if terminationAttested=false (terminationKind is capture-truncated or unknown), stopClassification=incomplete-observation and safeStopRank=traceOverhead=null regardless of any obligation's outcome, even if every obligation is mechanically stable-attainment; per-obligation stableAttainmentRank/overhead are still computed and emitted in this case; (2) else if any obligation's outcome=unmet-target-at-termination, stopClassification=unmet-target-at-termination-present and safeStopRank=traceOverhead=null; (3) else safeStopRank = max(stableAttainmentRank) across all obligations, traceOverhead = terminationRank - safeStopRank as a rank distance, and stopClassification=late-termination if traceOverhead>0 else on-target. traceOverhead must never be computed as, or coincidentally validated against, a sum of obligationResults[].overhead values; a conformance assertion must explicitly prove the all-stable-rollup fixture's traceOverhead is the max-based value and is strictly less than the naive sum of its per-obligation overheads. Canonical serialization for both new contracts and their fixtures: UTF-8, no byte-order mark, no insignificant whitespace, exactly one trailing newline byte, fixed property order exactly as enumerated above and in both docs, byte-idempotent under repeated normalization (StopAssessmentResultNormalizer or equivalent, mirroring EvaluationResultNormalizer's structure without duplicating its code). Implement TerminationDeclarationValidator sharing TraceValidator/ObligationLedgerValidator's existing internal structural-validation helpers (unknown-property rejection, duplicate-property rejection, size-limit enforcement) rather than duplicating them, and a new deterministic stop-assessment algorithm in a new ProgressTrace.Core.Assessment namespace that invokes but never reimplements ProgressTrace.Core.Evaluation.Evaluator; no other namespace may reimplement canonical-rank, stable-attainment, rank-distance, or rollup logic. Add a fourth CLI verb, assess <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path>, extending the usage line to 'progresstrace <validate|normalize> <path> | progresstrace evaluate <trace-path> <ledger-path> | progresstrace assess <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path>' without altering existing verbs, with exact stdout/stderr shapes, document field values ('trace','ledger','declaration'), and 0/1/2 exit-code precedence fixed in docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md's CLI assess behavior section: trace validates fully (reusing TraceValidator unmodified) before ledger-path is ever opened; ledger validates fully (reusing ObligationLedgerValidator unmodified, Phase A then Phase B against the validated trace) before termination-declaration-path is ever opened; declaration validates Phase A then Phase B against the validated trace; only when all three produce zero diagnostics does assess compute and emit the canonical StopAssessmentResult with exit 0; a PT000 anywhere or any oversized/unreadable file yields exit 2 with the correct document label at the correct stage, never opening a later document; any other diagnostic on any document yields exit 1; bad usage (wrong argument count or unrecognized leading verb, including an assess invocation with an argument count other than 4) writes the usage error to stderr and exits 2 without opening any file. Because tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/SchemaConformance.cs's minimal JSON-Schema-subset validator currently supports only type values object/array/string and a single scalar 'type' string, and StopAssessmentResult introduces integer, boolean, and nullable (['integer','null']) typed fields with no existing precedent in contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json, or contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json, extend SchemaConformance.MatchesType (and the 'type' handling in ValidateNode) to additionally support the primitive types 'integer', 'boolean', and 'null', and to support a JSON array value for the 'type' keyword (e.g. ['integer','null']) meaning the instance must match at least one listed type; do not add any new schema keyword name beyond the existing Supported allow-list, and do not change the existing object/array/string behavior used by the three frozen Phase 0/1 schemas, which must continue to validate identically. Fixture families, all under a new fixtures/termination/** subtree distinct from fixtures/valid/**, fixtures/invalid/**, and fixtures/obligations/**: (a) one new trace fixture fixtures/termination/traces/valid/non-contiguous-sequence-trace.json, a valid trace envelope with traceId synthetic-non-contiguous and exactly four events with non-contiguous raw sequence values 0, 5, 12, 20 (ids nc-evt-0..nc-evt-3 in that sequence order) to prove overhead/traceOverhead use canonical rank distance, never a raw sequence delta; (b) new ledger fixtures under fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/: on-target-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, pairs with the existing fixtures/valid/multi-event-trace.json, one obligation obl-a with a single signal at event-002=satisfied), mixed-rollup-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, obligations obl-a [signal at event-002=satisfied] and obl-b [signal at event-001=open, final and only signal, non-satisfied]), late-termination-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, single signal at nc-evt-0=satisfied), regression-no-recovery-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, signals nc-evt-0=satisfied then nc-evt-1=regressed, final=regressed), regression-then-recovery-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligation obl-a, signals nc-evt-0=satisfied, nc-evt-1=regressed, nc-evt-2=satisfied, final=satisfied, proving stableAttainmentRank is the later re-attainment's rank 2, not the first attainment's rank 0), all-stable-rollup-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, obligations obl-a [signal at nc-evt-0=satisfied, stableAttainmentRank=0] and obl-b [signal at nc-evt-2=satisfied, stableAttainmentRank=2], proving safeStopRank=max(0,2)=2 and, against termination at rank 3, traceOverhead=1, strictly less than the naive per-obligation overhead sum of 3+1=4); (c) new termination-declaration valid fixtures under fixtures/termination/valid/, each name ending in '-declaration.json': on-target-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, terminationEventId event-002, terminationKind natural-completion; pairs with multi-event-trace.json + on-target-ledger.json), capture-truncated-declaration.json (same trace+ledger pairing, terminationKind capture-truncated, proving stopClassification=incomplete-observation and safeStopRank/traceOverhead=null despite the obligation being mechanically stable-attainment), unknown-declaration.json (same trace+ledger pairing, terminationKind unknown, proving the identical suppression as capture-truncated since both are non-attested), zero-signal-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, terminationEventId event-002, terminationKind crash-or-error; pairs with multi-event-trace.json + the existing fixtures/obligations/valid/insufficient-evidence-ledger.json, proving a zero-signal obligation is unmet-target-at-termination with stableAttainmentRank=null and overhead=null), mixed-rollup-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, terminationEventId event-002, terminationKind timeout; pairs with multi-event-trace.json + mixed-rollup-ledger.json, proving stopClassification=unmet-target-at-termination-present overrides even though obl-a is individually stable), late-termination-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, terminationEventId nc-evt-3, terminationKind agent-self-reported-stop; pairs with non-contiguous-sequence-trace.json + late-termination-ledger.json, proving overhead=3 as a rank distance, never sequence 20-0=20), regression-no-recovery-declaration.json (same trace, terminationKind harness-declared-stop; pairs with regression-no-recovery-ledger.json, proving unmet-target-at-termination via regression with no recovery), regression-then-recovery-declaration.json (same trace, terminationKind external-cancellation; pairs with regression-then-recovery-ledger.json, proving stable-attainment at rank 2 with overhead=1), all-stable-rollup-declaration.json (same trace, terminationKind agent-self-reported-stop; pairs with all-stable-rollup-ledger.json, proving the non-summed safeStopRank/traceOverhead formula); (d) golden StopAssessmentResult fixtures under fixtures/termination/golden/, one per valid declaration fixture above sharing the exact same file name (mirroring fixtures/obligations/valid|golden's existing same-name convention), each the exact canonical byte-idempotent serialization for that declaration's trace+ledger+declaration triple; (e) invalid termination-declaration fixtures under fixtures/termination/invalid/, each named '<description>.PTxxx.json' with the expected code as the file-name suffix exactly like the existing fixtures/invalid and fixtures/obligations/invalid convention, each validated against fixtures/valid/multi-event-trace.json unless otherwise noted: malformed-json.PT000.json; unsupported-version.PT100.json (schemaVersion '2.0'); missing-termination-event-id.PT001.json; missing-termination-kind.PT001.json; invalid-termination-kind.PT101.json (terminationKind 'aborted' or another string outside the closed eight-value enum); wrong-type-schema-version.PT002.json (schemaVersion as a number); unknown-property.PT003.json; duplicate-property.PT004.json; dangling-termination-event-id.PT300.json (terminationEventId referencing a nonexistent event id); non-terminal-termination-event-id.PT301.json (terminationEventId='event-001', which exists but is not the trace's terminal event); mismatched-trace-id.PT302.json (traceId not equal to synthetic-multi-event). Do not author a PT005 (oversized-input) fixture file; test it programmatically with an in-memory oversized byte array exactly as AssertInputSizeBoundary and AssertLedgerStructuralBranches already do for the trace and ledger, reusing TraceValidator.MaximumInputSizeBytes. Extend tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/Program.cs (and add new files under tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/ as needed) to assert: full fixture discovery for every new directory above by exact expected file-name set (mirroring AssertDiscovery/AssertObligationFixtures); schema-to-runtime parity for every valid and invalid termination-declaration fixture against contracts/termination-declaration.schema.json and for every golden StopAssessmentResult against contracts/stop-assessment-result.schema.json, using the now-extended SchemaConformance; exact diagnostic code and, where material, exact pointer for every invalid fixture (PT300 at /terminationEventId, PT301 at /terminationEventId, PT302 at /traceId, plus the reused codes' existing pointer rules); byte-determinism and idempotence of StopAssessmentResult normalization (normalize twice, assert byte-identical, then assert byte-identical to the golden fixture); an explicit assertion that terminationAttested is false for both unknown and capture-truncated and true for the other six terminationKind values; an explicit assertion that safeStopRank and traceOverhead are null whenever terminationAttested is false, regardless of per-obligation outcomes; an explicit assertion that per-obligation overhead values are never summed to produce traceOverhead (using the all-stable-rollup fixture's 3+1=4 versus the correct 1); CLI positive-path parity for at least the on-target-declaration.json and all-stable-rollup-declaration.json triples (exit 0, stdout equals the corresponding golden fixture byte-for-byte); CLI negative-path parity mirroring CliConformance.cs's existing pattern for bad usage, unreadable/malformed/oversized trace, ledger, and declaration at each of the three staged positions, and at least one PT300/PT301/PT302 declaration failure through the full assess CLI path (not only the validator unit path), each asserting the correct document label, exact diagnostic code, and that no untrusted marker value is echoed in stdout/stderr. Extend .github/workflows/ci.yml to run the new assess acceptance commands and both new schema-validity checks alongside the existing Phase 0/1 build/conformance/validate/evaluate/format steps, without removing or reordering any existing step. Introduce zero new third-party package dependencies; all reads remain bounded by the existing 16 MiB TraceValidator.MaximumInputSizeBytes limit reused verbatim, with no new size limit invented. Before reporting the task complete, the builder must produce explicit self-check evidence, itemized against this objective, that every public enum value, every null-versus-omitted rule, every diagnostic code/pointer/precedence, every CLI stdout/stderr/exit path, the stable-attainment and rank-distance formulas, and every fixture family above is implemented and covered, and that no TODO/TBD/PLACEHOLDER/FIXME marker was introduced. After the builder completes, Hermes (the controller) independently re-executes every acceptance command below with zero writable repository paths, confirms a clean Release build, full conformance-suite pass, both existing Phase 0/1 CLI smoke checks, the new assess CLI/golden checks, both new schemas as valid JSON, dotnet format with zero diff, and that only this task's allowed_paths changed with the six frozen Phase 0/1 contract/doc files byte-identical to main, then assembles an evidence packet and diff bundle written outside the repository. For implementation review, Hermes then provisions a disposable, credential-free checkout or worktree pinned to the exact candidate commit, together with that evidence packet, and hands both to Antigravity in Mode B disposable reproducibility review; in that mode Antigravity may independently execute build, conformance, and CLI acceptance commands with ordinary build tooling inside the disposable checkout and may write only ephemeral build artifacts there, but has no network access, no credentials, no GitHub authority, and no push, merge, or write access to the original repository or to anything outside that disposable copy, and returns a structured verdict as JSON on stdout for Hermes to persist before the disposable environment is deleted. This task's own repair budget is bounded at max_repair_attempts=2; exceeding it is a stop condition, not a silent retry. Dragos reviews the diff, evidence packet, and verdict, and owns the sole final human integration decision via the normal PR flow; no automatic merge is permitted, and no role edits another role's owned artifacts.
